newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China industrial output 14 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China industrial output 14 pct in July.

text.p: China's industrial output is forecast to reach 427 billion yuan in July, or up by 14 percent compared with a year ago, the China Daily said on Tuesday.
However, output was expected to be 70 billion yuan lower than for June, it quoted a report by the State Economic and Trade Commission's information centre as saying.
Sectors such as petrochemicals, glass and brewing would overhaul their equipment during the month while some industries have been hit by floods, it said.
The report forecast steady growth in the economy with small fluctuations for the rest of the year, unlike the strong increases last year.
China's industrial output for the first six months grew by 11.6 percent.
